name: Kaihatsu (Nama) - Onsen Okami Kaihatsu
original_name: KAIHATSU(生)　温泉おかみ開発
source:
Main character gets a job at a big company. But his section manager is an incompetent woman, and he is forced to undertake difficult tasks day by day. This is a series of four different episodes united under female section manager abuse theme. In this episode main character gets a task to get sensitive information from a woman staying at hot springs resort.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角进入一家大公司工作，但他的女科长毫无能力，每天都把棘手的任务强加给他。这套系列由四个不同的篇章组成，均以女科长的虐待为共同主题。本篇中，主角接到的任务是从一名住在温泉度假村的女性那里获取敏感情报。
